definitions.explanation: Lacking a regular pattern or consistency. Often used as a な-adjective to describe schedules, habits, or patterns that are not consistent.

examples.japanese: {不規則|ふきそく}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦よくない→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: An irregular lifestyle is not good for you.

examples.japanese: {不規則|ふきそく}⟦{動詞|どうし}→動詞：03472_doushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だ。
⟦{睡眠|すいみん}→睡眠：03359_suimin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不規則|ふきそく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{体調|たいちょう}→体調：04644_taichou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{崩|くず}し→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧やすい。
examples.english: When your sleep becomes irregular, it's easy to get out of shape health-wise.

notes:
{不規則|ふきそく} describes a lack of regularity or pattern. It functions as both a noun and a na-adjective.

FORMS:
{不|ふ} (negation prefix) + ⟦{規則|きそく}→規則：01382_kisoku⟧ (rule, regularity)
- {不規則|ふきそく}な + noun: irregular ~ (modifier)
- {不規則|ふきそく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: irregularly (adverb)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不規則|ふきそく}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: irregular lifestyle
- {不規則|ふきそく}⟦{動詞|どうし}→動詞：03472_doushi⟧: irregular verb (grammar term)
- {不規則|ふきそく}な⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧: irregular meals
- {不規則|ふきそく}な⟦{勤務|きんむ}→勤務：04545_kinmu⟧: irregular work schedule

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{規則的|きそくてき}→規則的：23402_kisokuteki⟧: regular, systematic
- ⟦{規則正|きそくただ}しい→規則正しい：20039_kisokutadashii⟧: orderly, disciplined (often for lifestyle habits)
